title: Master's Programme in Computer Science
about: University of Helsinki's international Master's Programme in Computer Science for studies starting autumn 2027. The application period runs from 5 January 2027 (08:00) to 19 January 2027 (15:00).
requirements: A completed bachelor's degree or equivalent (applicants graduating after the application period can apply; offers are then conditional)
One intake per academic year; the online form is open only during the application period

upskill.name: AI Foundations
why: Field "Computer science" → AI Foundations Academy courses such as "Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I" ("Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"). No course objective covers the stated requirement ("A completed bachelor's degree or equivalent"); the top keyword candidate (A010.07, score 14.9) matched only "academic", so the Academy page is used instead of a specific course.
